app_factory.description: The ASGI application factory to run (e.g., 'main:app' for app.py).

ws.description: WebSocket protocol implementation (auto, none, websockets, wsproto).

log_level.description: Log level (critical, error, warning, info, debug, trace).

forwarded_allow_ips.description: Comma separated list of IP Addresses/IP Networks to trust with proxy headers.

headers.description: Custom HTTP response headers as 'Name:Value' strings. Items schema is flat string values.

items.description: Not a schema field, but defines the type of items in the 'headers' list if items schema was used. Since headers is list<string>, we use the flat string definition for clarity in some parsers, but here we adhere to the instruction: 'For a list-of-objects, add items as a FLAT map'. Headers is a list of strings, so we don't need items map. We just list<string>.
